report:
PMA terms / CDA GTFS / PMA timings / ICT routes - findings (fetched 2026-10-23, written up 2026-11-01)
Method: public pages and the public JSON endpoints the eTransit route planner itself calls. No login, no captcha, no personal data sent, User-Agent "Mozilla/5.0". At least 1.6 s between requests to government backends. Nothing in data/ was changed.

=== 1. PMA / eTransit / PITB / Punjab reuse terms ===
RESULT: no open-data licence, no terms of use, no API terms and no GTFS exist for PMA/PTC routes. The sites carry only "All Rights Reserved" style notices.
- https://etransit.punjab.gov.pk/ is an Angular app. I read the bundle main.47bbea11ddf6dbac.js and its lazy chunks.
  * Footer text in the bundle: "(c) Government of Punjab. All Rights Reserved."
  * The only "Disclaimer" is about payments: "The e-Transit Virtual Wallet and the T-Cash Card are two separate payment syst[ems]..."
  * There is no terms, privacy, licence or open-data route. The routes are: about, faq, contact, leadership, complaint, home, public, portal, auth.
  * The only "terms and conditions approved by PMA" text is a checkbox on the T-Card registration form. No terms text is linked.
- https://etransit.punjab.gov.pk/robots.txt returns the SPA HTML, meaning there is no robots file and no restriction.
- Public endpoints (no auth, called by /public/route-planner):
  * GET https://etransit.punjab.gov.pk/repo/backend/public/api/home-page/districts-with-lines?page=planner
  * POST .../home-page/get-line-schedules {line_id, main_route_id}
  * The bundle also names other hosts (api-transit.pitb.gov.pk, transit.pitb.gov.pk, afcbss.pitb.gov.pk, dev-* hosts). These were NOT called. The bundle has no GTFS or export endpoint.
- https://pma.punjab.gov.pk/
  * Footer: "(c) Punjab Masstransit Authority, Government of the Punjab".
  * These return 404: /terms, /terms-and-conditions, /disclaimer, /privacy-policy, /rti, /right-to-information, /proactive-disclosure, /sitemap.xml.
  * The /sitemap HTML page has no terms or RTI page.
  * /Laws links:
    - the PMA Act 2015
    - the PMA Ordinance 2015 (repealed)
    - the Punjab Metrobus Authority Act 2012
    - rules.pdf
    - "Gazzette Notification of Lahore Feeder Routes": https://pma.punjab.gov.pk/system/files/Gazzette%20Notification%20of%20Lahore%20Feeder%20Routes_0.pdf. It is 1.4 MB and probably a scan. No PDF text extractor was available, so it was NOT read. It is a LEAD for an officially notified feeder-route list.
    - "Lahore Feeder Routes Fare Notification".
  * /downloads, /routes_and_stations and /resource-center have no timetables. /lhr-feeder-routes-operational and /awareness-feeder-routes have no timings.
- https://www.pitb.gov.pk/privacy_policy has no reuse or licence clause. Its only related text is about data collection: "Your use of this application gives us the right to collect that information". /terms_of_use and /disclaimer return 404.
- https://www.punjab.gov.pk/
  * Footer: "(c) Government of the Punjab".
  * /terms returns 404, /disclaimer 403, /privacy_policy 404 and /open_data 404.
- Punjab open data portal:
  * opendata.punjab.gov.pk, data.punjab.gov.pk, open.punjab.gov.pk and punjab.data.gov.pk have no DNS record.
  * No Punjab (Pakistan) open-data policy or licence was found online. Search found only an undated World Bank/ITU "Open Data Initiative" news item and the federal draft policy on opendata.com.pk (already known).
- RTI:
  * https://rti.punjab.gov.pk/ is the Punjab Information Commission site. Footer: "Copyright (c)2015 Punjab Information Commission".
  * /proactive_disclosure lists only the Commission's own section 4 disclosures, nothing for PMA. PMA has no proactive-disclosure page.
  * So no proactively published PMA route list or timetable exists beyond the PMA route maps, the IPTN PDFs (already used) and the gazette above.
CONCLUSION: reuse status is unchanged from sources-apis.md. These are facts (stop names, times) taken from an official public interface that has no licence and carries "All Rights Reserved" notices. Keep citing eTransit. Written PMA permission (docs/OUTREACH.md) is still the clean path before republishing bulk timetables as GTFS.

=== 2. CDA Islamabad GTFS / timetables ===
RESULT: no public GTFS, API or JSON backend exists. The newest official timetables are the same 42 CDA PDFs.
- https://www.cda.gov.pk/cdaTransitMap
  * It still links the same 21 routes, each with a Forward and a Backward PDF: FR-01, 03A, 04, 04A, 05, 06, 07, 08A, 08C, 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 14A, 15, FRB-01, FRG-1, ST-01, ST-02. It also links Transit-Map-Islamabad-V-08.pdf.
  * HEAD Last-Modified on every route PDF is "Mon, 25 Aug 2025 07:29:3x GMT", so nothing is newer. The V-08 map is dated "Tue, 04 Nov 2025". V-09 and V-10 return 404.
  * The page is static, with no JSON backend. robots.txt is "User-agent: * / Disallow:" (allows everything).
- https://www.cda.gov.pk/termsAndConditions ("Mobile App & Website Terms and Conditions"). Exact clauses:
  * "8. Intellectual Property - All designs, content, and logos are the property of CDA. Unauthorized use or reproduction is prohibited."
  * "12. Disclaimer of Accuracy - While CDA endeavors to keep information accurate and up-to-date, it does not guarantee that all data, fares, schedules, or announcements are error-free."
  * "14. User Conduct - Users shall not use the App/Website for unlawful purposes, attempts to hack, reverse engineer, or misuse CDA services."
  * Footer: "Copyright (c) 2024. All rights reserved". There is no open licence.
- Official app: "CDA Mobile App", Play id com.kentkart.cdamobile (APP report, Aug 2025, https://www.app.com.pk/?p=1055605).
  * It is built by Kentkart, the same vendor as the SMTA Peoples Bus app, and runs on Kentkart's private API (sources-apis.md #4).
  * The API was NOT probed, because CDA clause 14 forbids reverse engineering.
  * Live tracking in Google Maps implies CDA sends Google a GTFS/GTFS-RT partner feed. That feed is not public.
- Aggregators:
  * transit.land: an operator search for "islamabad" returns "No agencies match". Its API needs a key, so it was not queried.
  * Mobility Database is already known to be empty.
  * No Moovit Islamabad page appeared in search, so nothing is cited.
  * OpenMobilityData has no Pakistan archive (see sources-ecosystem-deep.md).
- News updates NOT yet in data. These are secondary sources; the operator is CDA's "Capital Mass Transit Authority/Wing".
  * From 2026-09-03, FR-08B, FR-09 and FR-14 run every 12 min instead of every 15 (TechJuice, https://www.techjuice.pk/?p=251552). Data has FR-09 = 15, FR-14 = 15 and FR-08B = null.
  * From 2026-10-20, FR-13 (Golra Morr - Fateh Jang) is discontinued, and FR-10 now runs only Golra - B-17 instead of Golra - Taxila (ProPakistani, https://propakistani.pk/2026/10/20/islamabad-changes-two-feeder-bus-routes/). Data still has FR-13 operational and FR-10 running to Taxila.
  * An undated TechJuice notice ends FR-08B's evening service early: last bus 19:00 from Khanna Pul and 20:00 from Nilore (https://www.techjuice.pk/islamabad-revises-timings-for-two-electric-bus-routes/; year not confirmed).
- Ask: file an RTI with CDA for the GTFS behind the PDFs. The draft is already in docs/OUTREACH.md.

=== 3. PMA/PTC timetables (done) ===
- All 184 eTransit routes were fetched, across 40 lines (39 districts, including the Lahore, Multan and Rawalpindi lines). That is 368 directions.
  * Each direction has the full daily timetable for service date 2026-10-23 (a Friday): every trip and every stop time.
  * "timings" summarises each direction: first and last departure, median headway and its range, departures per day, last arrival, run time and stop count.
- Matching to data/systems:
  * 338 directions match with high confidence. Most of these data routes already cite the same PMA/safar route id.
  * 8 are medium, and 22 have no match.
  * Two matches were set by hand: eTransit 136 -> isb-rwp-metrobus RED, and eTransit 40 -> multan-feeder MFR01C.
- 29 directions are flagged timetable_partial_or_suspect (fewer than 5 trips, or less than a 10 h span). Do not take hours or headway from flagged rows. Examples:
  * Orange Line: 09:00-16:35, 14 trips; clearly partial.
  * RWP-EB-04: 2 trips. RED-537: 2 trips. RED-538: 06:00-06:45 only.
  * eTransit 100 and 172: 1-2 trips. Sargodha Mid Ranjha: 1 trip.
  * Multan MFR-EV launch routes (487, 489 and others).
  * MFR09: 19:40-21:40.
- eTransit routes with NO data route. These are candidates to add; their stops are in research/cache/pma-timings/et_sched.json and et_sched.jsonl.
  * 99 Rawalpindi "Umar Baig Chowk to TB Hospital" (10-min headway, 06:00-22:00)
  * 309 LFR-Speedo "Shahdara to Gajjumata"
  * 549 Khanewal "Khanewal to Qadirpur Raan"
  * 556 Chiniot "Tehsil Chowk to Bhutto Colony"
  * 560 and 561 Gujranwala, a new district with no system file: "Gondlanwala to Qila Didar Singh" and "Khayali Bypass to Nandipur"
  * 567 Okara "GBS Okara to Adda Gamber"
  * 568 Attock "GBS Attock to Hassan Abdal"
  * 569 and 571 Bhakkar: "Khanser" and "Saray-e-Muhajir"
  * 570 Lodhran "Lodhran to Basti Malook"
- Data routes with no eTransit route:
  * isb-rwp-metrobus ORANGE, BLUE and GREEN. These are CDA-run, so this is expected.
  * lahore-feeder RT-01, 02, 06, 22, 26 and 29-34. All are 'unverified'. They are not in eTransit, which suggests they are not running.
- Data quality flags:
  * RWP-EB-01 and RWP-EB-01X may have their names swapped. See match_method for eTransit 100 and 172.
  * Data RT-20 "Sharif Medical City - Ali Town" cites safar id 260, but eTransit 260 is "Mull Adda to Jinnah Bus Terminal".
- These are official scheduled times from PMA's public planner, for one day only. Until PMA grants permission, store them as route hours and headway with source_url, not as GTFS stop_times.

=== 4. ICT / ITA routes 101-133 ===
- https://ictadministration.gov.pk/public-transport-fares/ (Information Box: "Dealing Authority: Secretary, ITA")
  * It lists 16 route fare sheets as Google Drive links: 127A, 133, 127, 124, 131, 122A, 121, 124A, 122, 120, 111, 110, 115, 105, 101 and 104A.
  * The Drive links tested return HTTP 404 (files removed or private).
  * The page gives no terminals or via points.
  * Wayback CDX has no capture of the page or of the Drive files.
- data/systems/islamabad-rawalpindi-private-wagons.json already holds routes 101-134 (unverified; from the ITA 2009 list on Scribd and other sources). No newer official list with terminals or via points was found, so research/incoming/ict-ita-routes.json was NOT created.
- Gap: the ITA route-permit register needs an RTI to the Secretary, ITA, ICT Administration Complex G-11/4.

=== Files and safety ===
- Nothing was saved from web.archive.org or any other archived site. The CDX JSON was read in memory only, and it was empty. No .hta, .vbs, .exe, .doc or .xls files were saved.
- research/cache/pma-timings/ holds raw copies of CURRENT official pages. They were saved before the no-raw-HTML rule. None was executed and none looks suspicious, but the owner may remove them:
  * eTransit Angular bundles: main.js, runtime.js, c66.*.js, c361.*.js, c496.*.js, c529.*.js, c569.*.js, c740.*.js, c954.*.js
  * HTML: index.html, pma_home.html, p_*.html, pg.html, cda_tm.html, ict_fares.html
  * PDF: gazette_lfr.pdf (the PMA gazette, never opened)
  * raw JSON: dwl.json, raw41.json
- Clean outputs:
  * et_sched.json and et_sched.jsonl: compact stops and times for each route.
  * Scripts: fetch_all.py, parse_raw.py, load.py, build.py, check.py.
  * Python in this sandbox cannot create files, so build.py prints to stdout and PowerShell saves the result.
notes: One record per eTransit route and direction. first/last = first and last scheduled departure from the first stop; headway_min = median gap between departures that day; headway_range_min = [min, max] gap.
Timetable is the one eTransit served for service date 2026-10-23 (a Friday). Other days may differ.
route_id_guess is a machine match to data/systems; check match_method/match_confidence before merging.

timetable_partial_or_suspect = fewer than 5 departures or under 10 hours between first and last departure (launch-week or placeholder timetables, e.g. Orange Line, some Multan MFR-EV, RWP-EB-04, RED-537/538). Do not set hours/headway from these.
